MCP server for YouTube music downloading with task queue, progress tracking, and cross-platform support

latestVersion.changelog:
Major update: bootleg-link is now an MCP server with Node.js, supporting queue and progress over the Model Context Protocol.

- Migrated to Node.js with MCP server architecture; requires Node 18+.
- Replaces shell scripts and file-based state with an in-memory task queue (persistent SQLite planned).
- New MCP tools: submit, query, list, pause, resume, cancel, and clear tasks programmatically.
- Provides structured JSON APIs for task management and progress tracking.
- Project files reorganized, TypeScript source, and build outputs added.
- Shell-script interface and direct yt-dlp integration are now deprecated; future releases will restore full yt-dlp support and persistent storage.
